title: WPSS/81/2005 of SMT. RAVTI DEVI Vs STATE

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH CORUT OF UTTARANCHAL AT NAINITAL
Civil Writ Petition No. 81 of 2005 (S/S)
Smt. Ravti Devi
W/o Sri Rajesh Thapa
............. Petitioner
Versus
1. State of Uttaranchal
through Secretary
Department of Industries, Dehradun.
2. Joint Director Industries
Dehradun.
3. General Manager
District Industry Centre, Almora
4. Assistant Manager
District Industry Centre,
Charchula (Pithoragarh).
.............. Respondents
None for the petitioner.
Mr. Paresh Tripathi, Brief Holder for respondents.
Hon'ble Prafulla C. Pant, J.
None present for the petitioner.
Learned Brief Holder for the State is present.
2) By means of this writ petition, the petitioner, a junior
craftsman (on contractual temporary appointment) with
District Industry Center, has sought her regularization in
service.
3) In view of the principle of law laid down in Secretary
State of Karnataka Vs. Uma Devi, reported in 2006
A.I.R.S.C.W. Page 1991, that daily wage workers and the
persons employed without undergoing regular selection
process under the rules, should not be permitted to be

absorbed or regularized in the service, against the
Constitutional Scheme of public employment, this Court is
not inclined to issue direction to regularise services of the
petitioners.
4) Therefore, the writ petition is dismissed. Interim order
dated 08.02.2005, stands vacated. (All pending applications
in this Petition also stand disposed of).
(Prafulla C. Pant, J.)
Dt.: November 15, 2006
H.Negi
